title: jasminum sambac
intro: Jasminum sambac, commonly known as the Star Jasmine or Night-blooming Jasmine, is a fragrant flowering evergreen vine native to tropical Asia. This plant is valued for its delicate white flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Jasminum sambac include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which have been attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Jasminum sambac, such as jasmone and jasmonic acid, have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-cancer properties, further solidifying its potential as a natural remedy.
